preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of cities n must be between 3 and 1,000,000 inclusive.
The subset size q must be between 3 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.strip()) <= (n * (n - 1) // 2) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit())
postconditions.description: Each output line must be a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of roads to demolish, which cannot exceed the total possible roads (n choose 2).

postconditions.expression: all((n * (n - 1) // 2) - int(line.strip()) >= max(0, (n - q + 1) * (q - 1) // 2) for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit())
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output must be the minimum number of roads to demolish such that no subset of size q has all roads intact. This is equivalent to ensuring the complement graph (demolished roads) contains at least one missing edge in every subset of size q. The minimum number of roads to demolish is the total roads minus the maximum number of edges in a graph where no subset of size q is complete (clique). The formula for the maximum edges in such a graph is (n - q + 1) * (q - 1) // 2, derived from Turán's theorem for q-cliques.
